phase1.explanation:
🦀 **Closures are anonymous functions that capture variables.**

**Closure traits:**

| Trait | What it means |
|-------|---------------|
| `Fn` | Can be called multiple times, no mutation |
| `FnMut` | Can be called multiple times, can mutate |
| `FnOnce` | Can be called once, takes ownership |

**Closure capture modes:**

| Mode | What it does |
|------|--------------|
| `&self` | Borrow immutably |
| `&mut self` | Borrow mutably |
| `self` | Take ownership (move) |

**Rust-chan says:**
"Closures are flexible. They can capture variables by reference, mutable reference, or ownership."

**When to use closures:**
| Situation | Use closures |
|-----------|--------------|
| Short functions | ✅ |
| Iterators | ✅ |
| Callbacks | ✅ |
| Capturing context | ✅ |

phase2.errorMessage: (No error — this works if the closure borrows. But if the closure takes ownership, it would fail.)
